checkpoint: Native document metadata pagination, durable upload recovery, and appointment rescheduling

changes.document_pages: Owner metadata pages of20, explicit lazy full-detail fetch, version-aware ID deduplication; retryable page failure preserves loaded rows and edited review; expired cursor requires explicit restart; auth/access failure clears server-loaded content.
changes.upload_recovery: Bounded owner-keyed SecureStore record stores cached local URI/name/MIME/size, request UUID and explicit consent only. No document text or bytes are stored in the recovery record. Persist before POST; all uncertain/errors retain exact identity and lock replacement. Committed lookup can recover without a local cached file.404 never proves absence. Explicit local discard requires history-review acknowledgement and never deletes server documents. Existing review drafts survive lookup.
changes.missing_cache: Upload retry rejects a missing, empty or size-changed cached file. The original UUID is retained and lookup remains available. A missing lookup leaves uncertainty visible; user may explicitly discard only local recovery after reviewing history. No claim that a404 means the upload failed.
changes.rescheduling: New same-doctor/same-country future published slot with expected revision and stable saved UUID. Reservation is changed atomically by backend; result remains requested pending new acceptance. Only explicit structured409 noncommit proof unlocks selection; all other errors retain exact request. Pending recovery remains reachable after lifecycle/payment changes. Cleanup removes only matching UUID.
changes.clinician_revision: Native accept/start passes the displayed reschedule_revision, fails closed on missing revision, refreshes on409 without retrying a changed consultation.
changes.session: Booking, rescheduling and persisted upload work bind API calls to the session generation captured before asynchronous SecureStore writes; late account switch cannot send under a replacement account.
